WITH CAH AS
(
    SELECT
    AS_OF_DATE
    ,CRDACCT_NBR
    ,CRDACCT_CUST_NBR
    ,CUST_CIF_NBR
    ,CRDACCT_BNK_CODE
    ,CRDACCT_SOURCE_CODE
    ,CRDACCT_PDT_NBR
    ,CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN
    ,CRDACCT_OUTSTD_BAL
    ,CRDACCT_OUTSTD_INSTL
    ,CRDACCT_STMT_BAL_RTL
    ,CRDACCT_STMT_BAL_CASH
    ,CRDACCT_CRLIMIT
    FROM eds.EDS_CTL
    INNER JOIN eds.CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT
        ON CRM_DATE = AS_OF_DATE
            AND CRDACCT_NBR IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 
    AS_OF_DATE
    ,CRDACCT_NBR
    ,CRDACCT_CUST_NBR
    ,CUST_CIF_NBR
    ,CRDACCT_BNK_CODE
    ,CRDACCT_SOURCE_CODE
    ,CRDACCT_PDT_NBR
    ,CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN
    ,CRDACCT_OUTSTD_BAL
    ,CRDACCT_OUTSTD_INSTL
    ,CRDACCT_STMT_BAL_RTL
    ,CRDACCT_STMT_BAL_CASH
    ,CRDACCT_CRLIMIT
)

, CCD_BRANCH AS
(
    SELECT *
        ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APPM_ACCT_NBR ORDER BY BD DESC) AS RN
    FROM
    (
    SELECT APPM_ACCT_NBR, SUBSTRING(APPM_SOURCE,7,4) AS BRANCH_CODE, LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) AS BD FROM busc.CCD_CBCEXAPPMP WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1 GROUP BY APPM_ACCT_NBR, SUBSTRING(APPM_SOURCE,7,4), LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT APPM_ACCT_NBR, SUBSTRING(APPM_SOURCE,7,4) AS BRANCH_CODE, LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) AS BD FROM busc.CCD_CBCEXAPPFP WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1 GROUP BY APPM_ACCT_NBR, SUBSTRING(APPM_SOURCE,7,4), LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8)
    ) A
)

SELECT
CAH.CRDACCT_NBR	AS	AccountID
,CAH.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR	AS	CustomerID
,NULL	AS	EntityCIF
,CAH.CUST_CIF_NBR	AS	FCBSCIF
,CAH.CRDACCT_BNK_CODE	AS	BankCode
,CCD_BRANCH.BRANCH_CODE	AS	BranchCode
,BR.SOL_DESC	AS	BranchName
,BR.AREA	AS	Area
,BR.REGION	AS	Region
,CAH.CRDACCT_SOURCE_CODE	AS	Source
,PROD.PRODUCT_GROUP	AS	ProductGrouping
,PROD.PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION	AS	ProductType
,CONCAT(PROD.PRODUCT_GROUP,'-',PROD.PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION)	AS	ProductDetails
,CAST(CAST(CAH.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN AS VARCHAR) AS DATE) AS	OpenedDate
,CASE WHEN CAH.CRDACCT_OUTSTD_BAL > 0 AND CAH.CRDACCT_OUTSTD_INSTL > 0 THEN CAH.CRDACCT_OUTSTD_BAL + CAH.CRDACCT_OUTSTD_INSTL
    WHEN CAH.CRDACCT_OUTSTD_BAL <= 0 AND CAH.CRDACCT_OUTSTD_INSTL <= 0 THEN 0
    WHEN CAH.CRDACCT_OUTSTD_BAL > 0 AND CAH.CRDACCT_OUTSTD_INSTL <= 0  THEN CAH.CRDACCT_OUTSTD_BAL
    WHEN CAH.CRDACCT_OUTSTD_BAL <= 0 AND CAH.CRDACCT_OUTSTD_INSTL > 0  THEN CAH.CRDACCT_OUTSTD_INSTL END AS	RelationshipExposure_Full
,NULL AS RelationshipExposure_Prorated
,CAH.CRDACCT_STMT_BAL_RTL + CAH.CRDACCT_STMT_BAL_CASH AS	DueForTheMonth_Full
,NULL	AS	DueForTheMonth_Prorated
,CAH.CRDACCT_CRLIMIT	AS	CreditLimit_Full
,NULL	AS	CreditLimit_Prorated
,CAST(CAST(CAH.AS_OF_DATE AS VARCHAR) AS DATE)	AS	BusinessDate
,CAST(CAST(CAH.AS_OF_DATE AS VARCHAR) AS DATE)	AS	LastUpdatedDate
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAH.CRDACCT_NBR)	AS	AccountKey
FROM CAH
    LEFT JOIN eds.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING PROD
        ON CAST(CAH.CRDACCT_PDT_NBR AS varchar(8)) = PROD.PRODUCT_TYPE
        AND CAH.CRDACCT_BNK_CODE = PROD.BANK_CODE
        AND CAH.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN PROD.SCD_START_DATE AND PROD.SCD_END_DATE
    LEFT JOIN CCD_BRANCH
        ON CAH.CRDACCT_NBR = CCD_BRANCH.APPM_ACCT_NBR
        AND RN = 1
    LEFT JOIN eds.BRANCH_DIM BR
        ON CCD_BRANCH.BRANCH_CODE = BR.SOL_ID
        AND CAH.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN BR.SCD_START_DATE AND BR.SCD_END_DATE
        AND BR.BANK_ID = 'CBC01';
